definitions.explanation: A Japanese banknote with a face value of 5,000 yen. One of the standard denominations of Japanese paper currency.

examples.japanese: {五千円札|ごせんえんさつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can I pay with a five-thousand-yen bill?

examples.japanese: ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{五千円札|ごせんえんさつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: There is one five-thousand-yen bill in my wallet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{五千円札|ごせんえんさつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{津田梅子|つだうめこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肖像|しょうぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The new five-thousand-yen bill features a portrait of Tsuda Umeko.

notes:
The {五千円札|ごせんえんさつ} is one of four denominations of Japanese banknotes. As of 2024, the bill features {津田梅子|つだうめこ}, a pioneer in women's education in Japan. The previous design (2004-2024) featured {樋口一葉|ひぐちいちよう}, a Meiji-era novelist.

JAPANESE BANKNOTE DENOMINATIONS:
- ⟦{千円札|せんえんさつ}→千円札：16603_senensatsu⟧: 1,000 yen bill
- {五千円札|ごせんえんさつ}: 5,000 yen bill
- ⟦{一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}→一万円札：26562_ichimanensatsu⟧: 10,000 yen bill

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {五千円札|ごせんえんさつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay with a 5,000-yen bill
- {五千円札|ごせんえんさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧: to break a 5,000-yen bill (into smaller bills/coins)
- {五千円札|ごせんえんさつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{両替|りょうがえ}→両替：03680_ryougae⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exchange for a 5,000-yen bill

CULTURAL NOTE:
In daily life, the {五千円札|ごせんえんさつ} is commonly used for mid-range purchases. When giving money as a gift (⟦ご{祝儀|しゅうぎ}→ご祝儀：08356_goshuugi⟧), odd numbers of bills are preferred, making this denomination useful.
